import asyncio
from robotblocks_runtime import *
from machine import Pin, PWM


adc_36 = rb_adc(36, "basico-234")

async def proceso_1():
    while True:
        print(rb_finite(rb_adc_read(adc_36, "basico-234"), "basico-234"))
        await rb_wait(0.5)
        await rb_yield()

async def main():
    await rb_run(proceso_1)

asyncio.run(main())
